files.description: The KiCad source files of both revisions.

routeMetrics.description: Route metrics of both revisions, for the PCB tab's routing review.

projectDiff.description: ecad-viewer's input: the native changes of both tabs, and the navigation from each change id.

description:
Every Design Comparison tab except fabrication between two revisions
(`prism-kicad compare -o`).
title: Design compare result a1

revisionKey.description: The revision key of the commit (revision-key.md).

bundleKey.description: The bundle key the revision was read from. Absent when it was read from its source tree.

projectFile.description: The project file the revision was compared by (`config.project_file`).

base.description: The base revision's `.kicad_sch`, `.kicad_pcb` and `.kicad_pro` files, sorted by `path` in code point order.

head.description: The head revision's files, in the same order.

DesignCompareFiles.description: The KiCad source files of both revisions.

changes.description: The tab's changes, sorted by `id` in code point order.

fields.description: The BOM columns shown, in display order.

changes.description: The BOM rows, sorted by `ref` in code point order.

present.description: True when either revision has a stackup.

changed.description: True when the two revisions' stackups or settings differ.

base.description: The base revision's forms, in stack order from front to back. Empty without a stackup.

head.description: The head revision's forms, in stack order from front to back. Empty without a stackup.

base.description: Keys are net names; the base revision's routed nets.

head.description: Keys are net names; the head revision's routed nets.

schema.description: Document schema id, in ecad-viewer's spelling.

provider.description: Who produced the diff: `prism-semantic` for Prism.

navigation.description: Keys are review item ids (`DesignCompareChange.id`); each maps to the native changes ecad-viewer selects for it.

diagnostics.description: Review items that resolved to no native object, in review order. Empty when there are none.

Sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest: exactly 64 characters, no prefix such as `sha256:`.

RepoPath.description:
Repository-relative POSIX path, exactly as `git ls-tree` names the entry:
`/`-separated, case preserved, no leading `/`, no empty, `.` or `..`
segment, no backslash and no `:`. The same character rule as ArchivePath.
It is the only path type in bundle documents: a file has one spelling
whichever project in the repository refers to it, and a file outside the
project directory needs no `..`.

path.description: The file's path relative to the project directory (amendment C2 D1).

DesignCompareSourceFile.description: One KiCad source file of a revision, as the file list and the overlay show it.

id.description: The change's id, stable for the same pair; the key of `projectDiff.navigation`.

domain.description: The tab the change belongs to.

label.description: The review list's text for the change.

objectKind.description: The object's kind as the board-objects member names it, for example `footprint` or `sheet-pin`. Absent for a net-level change.

reference.description: The component's reference designator. Absent when the change is not about a component.

net.description: The net the change is about. Absent when it is not about a net.

semanticId.description: The identity that groups changes of one design entity (component, net or object) across tabs. Absent when the change has none.

page.description: The document the review list files the change under, relative to the project directory. Absent when the change has none (a project setting).

reasons.description: Why the object counts as changed, in classification order. Never empty.

fields.description: Keys are field display names (for example `Position`, `Net`, `Value`); each holds the changed field's old and new value. Empty when no field changed.

base.description: Where the object is in the base revision. Absent for an added object.

head.description: Where the object is in the head revision. Absent for a removed object.

DesignCompareChange.description: One change in the Schematic or PCB tab.

old.description: Keys are BOM column names; the base revision's text of each. Absent for an added row.

new.description: Keys are BOM column names; the head revision's text of each. Absent for a removed row.

diffs.description: Keys are BOM column names; only the columns that differ. Absent for an added, removed or unchanged row.

DesignCompareBomRow.description: One BOM row, keyed by reference designator.

type.description: The layer's KiCad type, for example `copper` or `prepreg`. Absent when the board writes none.

thicknessNm.description: The layer's thickness. Absent when the board writes none or writes 0.

material.description: The layer's material. Absent when the board writes none.

color.description: The layer's colour. Absent when the board writes none.

epsilonR.description: The relative permittivity. Absent when the board writes none.

lossTangent.description: The loss tangent. Absent when the board writes none.

DesignCompareStackupLayer.description: One stackup form, as the Stackup tab shows it (`field-maps/stackup.md` DC rules: sub-layers folded to forms).

copperFinish.description: The copper finish. Absent when the board writes none.

dielectricConstraints.description: Whether impedance-controlled dielectric constraints are on. Absent when the board has no stackup.

documents.description: One entry per document with at least one change, sorted by `path` in code point order.

KiCadProjectDiffProject.description: The project part of the diff.

reason.description: Why, in ecad-viewer's vocabulary, for example `missing-source-id`.

KiCadProjectDiffDiagnostic.description: A review item no native object could be found for.

DesignCompareDomain.description: The tab a change belongs to.

DesignCompareChangeKind.description: What a change does, in the review's vocabulary.

DesignCompareCategory.description: The review category of a change (`frontend/src/lib/diff-grouping`).

DesignCompareClassification.description: How prominently a change is reviewed.

Refdes.description:
Reference designator as KiCad resolves it for one symbol instance or
footprint, for example `R1`, `U3`, `#PWR01` or `R?`. Always a string. A
contract states whether it includes virtual (`#`) and unannotated (`?`)
references.

NetName.description:
KiCad full net name as KiCad resolves it, including the sheet path prefix
of a local net (`/Power/VBUS`), a global name (`GND`) or a generated name
(`Net-(R1-Pad2)`, `unconnected-(U1-PA0-Pad3)`). "No net" is expressed by
omitting the field, never by an empty name.

DesignCompareReason.description: Why an object counts as changed. Several may apply.

reviewOnly.description: True when the change has no object ecad-viewer can paint (for example a project setting). Absent means false.

connectivity.description: A net's terminal changes. Absent for a change that is not a net.

instanceCount.description: The number of instances of a symbol. Absent when it did not change.

labelInstances.description: The number of labels of a net. Absent when it did not change.

sheetChange.description: The sheet the object is on. Absent when it did not change.

targets.description: The objects ecad-viewer highlights for the change: base-side targets first, then head-side, each in the order the change's evidence lists them (field map, "Targets"). One entry per object and sheet instance. Absent when there are none, as for a change with `reviewOnly`.

DesignCompareChangeDetails.description: Review evidence of a change beyond its fields.

sourceId.description: The object's native identity in this revision: its UUID, or for a net, the source id of its first labelled item.

parentSourceId.description: The parent object's UUID (a pad's footprint, a pin's symbol). Absent for a top-level object.

documentPath.description: The document the object is in, relative to the project directory.

layer.description: The object's layer as written. Absent for an object without one.

layers.description: Every layer the object occupies in this revision, sorted in code point order. Empty for a schematic object.

at.description: The object's position. Absent for an object without one (a net, a zone).

reference.description: The object's reference designator in this revision. Absent when it has none.

net.description: The object's net in this revision. Absent when it has none.

DesignCompareChangeSide.description: One side of a changed object: where it is in that revision.

DesignCompareBomStatus.description: The state of one BOM row.

Count.description: A count of things: a non-negative safe integer.

Nanometres.description:
Length or coordinate in integer nanometres, KiCad's internal board unit.
Converted from the file's decimal millimetres as KiCad's own parser does:
the double product value_mm * 1e6, rounded half away from zero. A single
coordinate or dimension fits KiCad's 32-bit range; sums (for example a
net's total track length) may not, hence a safe integer (|n| < 2^53).

routeLengthNm.description: The total centreline length of the net's tracks and arcs.

usedLayers.description: Every copper layer the net occupies, sorted in code point order.

viaBarrelLengthNm.description: The summed via barrel length. Absent when it is unreliable (a via span the stackup cannot measure).

DesignCompareRouteMetric.description: One net's routing in one revision (`field-maps/route-metrics.md` C2 rules).

path.description: The document's path, relative to the project directory (amendment C2 D1).

changes.description: The document's native changes, in review order.

changeId.description: The first native change id in the first document.

changeIds.description: Every native change id in the first document, in review order.

documents.description: One entry per document, in review order. Absent when the review item touches one document.

KiCadProjectDiffNavigation.description: Where one review item's native changes sit: its first document, and every document when there is more than one.

old.description: The base revision's value: a text, number or flag; a list in the order the object writes it; or a table whose keys are KiCad's setting keys, in code point order. Absent when the base has none.

new.description: The head revision's value, encoded as `old` is (lists in the order the object writes them; table keys are KiCad's setting keys, in code point order). Absent when the head has none.

DesignCompareFieldDelta.description: One side's old and new value of a changed field.

addedTerminals.description: Terminals (`<reference>.<pin>`) only on the head side, sorted in code point order.

removedTerminals.description: Terminals only on the base side, sorted in code point order.

DesignCompareConnectivity.description: Terminals a net gained and lost.

old.description: The base revision's sheet path. Absent when the base has none.

new.description: The head revision's sheet path. Absent when the head has none.

side.description: The pane the object is drawn in: `base` for the base revision's object, `head` for the head's.

sourceId.description: The object's native identity in that revision: its UUID, or for a terminal its pin's UUID (its symbol's when the pin has none).

kind.description: The object's kind as the board-objects member names it, for example `pin` or `sheet-pin`. Absent when the target is only a role (a net's terminal with no pin object of its own).

role.description: How the object is drawn. Absent when it has no role beyond its `kind`.

documentPath.description: The document the object is in, relative to the project directory. Absent when it is not known.

at.description: The object's position. Absent for an object without one.

sheetPath.description: The sheet instance path of a schematic object (`/` for the root sheet). Absent on the board, and for a schematic object whose instance is not known.

reference.description: The component reference designator the object belongs to. Absent when it belongs to none.

DesignCompareTarget.description: One object ecad-viewer highlights for a change. The review list reads the targets' kinds, roles, documents, positions and references; `projectDiff` is built from the same targets.

KiCadUuid.description:
KiCad object UUID in the canonical form KiCad writes (`KIID::AsString`):
lowercase hexadecimal, 8-4-4-4-12. Copied from the file, never generated
or re-cased.

LayerName.description:
KiCad canonical layer name as the board file's `(layers …)` table spells
it, for example `F.Cu`, `In1.Cu`, `B.Mask`, `Edge.Cuts` or `User.1`. Never
the user-assigned layer name, which a contract carries in a separate
optional field. Never a wildcard set such as `*.Cu` or `F&B.Cu`.

xNm.description: X coordinate in nanometres, +x to the right.

PointNm.description:
A point in nanometres in KiCad's board frame: +x to the right, +y down, as
in the file and never flipped. The field holding the point states whether
it is board-absolute or footprint-local. For camelCase (projection)
documents only.

DesignCompareBomFieldDiff.description: One field of a changed BOM row.

NonNegativeNanometres.description: A Nanometres value that is never negative: a thickness, width, diameter or length.

KiCadProjectDiffDocType.description: The KiCad file type of one document of the diff.

id.description: The object's native identity: its KIID path, or its UUID when it has no path.

typeName.description: KiCad's C++ type name of the object, for example `SCH_SYMBOL`, `PCB_TRACK` or `ZONE`; `EDA_ITEM` when no specific type applies.

kind.description: What the change does to the object.

sourceSide.description: The revision pane the object is painted in.

properties.description: The properties that differ, sorted by `name` in code point order. Empty for a child change.

bbox.description: Bounds `[x0, y0, x1, y1]`, in that order, in KiCad document millimetres. Absent in Prism's output; native KiCad diffs carry it.

refdes.description: The reference designator, or the net name for a net-level change. Absent when the change has neither.

retainReference.description: True when the reference pane keeps the object visible although the change belongs to the comparison. Absent means false.

children.description: Further objects of the same review item in this document, in review order. Empty when there are none.

KiCadProjectDiffItemChange.description:
One changed KiCad object ecad-viewer resolves against its own parsed scene
and highlights. ecad-viewer measures the geometry itself, so `bbox` is
absent in Prism's output.

changeId.description: The first native change id of the review item in this document.

changeIds.description: Every native change id of the review item in this document, in review order.

KiCadProjectDiffNavigationDocument.description: Where one review item's native changes sit in one document.

anyOf.description: A number as today's index writes it.
A list of texts, in the order today's index writes them.
A list of numbers, in the order today's index writes them.
One table of settings (for example a teardrop parameter set).
A list of tables, in the order today's index writes them.

BoardObjectsReviewValue.description:
One review-field value, as Design Comparison shows it: the value today's
index writes, unconverted (lengths stay the millimetres the file writes,
flags stay booleans, `Size` stays a `w × h` text). A presentation value,
not a typed fact: typed lengths of this member are the `…Nm` fields. A
value of any other shape is written as its canonical JSON text (field
map).

DesignCompareSide.description: The pane a target is drawn in.

DesignCompareTargetRole.description: How a target is drawn and reviewed: the object's own kind, or the part it plays in the change (a net's `terminal`, a component's `component`).

KiCadProjectDiffChangeKind.description: What a native change does to its object, in ecad-viewer's vocabulary.

KiCadProjectDiffSourceSide.description: The revision pane a native change is painted in.

name.description: The property's display name, for example `Position` or `Net`.

KiCadProjectDiffProperty.description: One property that differs between the two revisions of a native change.

BoardObjectsReviewTable.description: A flat table of settings; keys are KiCad's setting keys as written, serialized in code point order.

v.description: The value; `null` exactly when `type` is `null` (ecad-viewer's encoding).

label.description: A display label ecad-viewer shows instead of `v`. Absent when `v` is shown as is.

KiCadProjectDiffValue.description: One side's value of a property: its encoding and the value.

BoardObjectsReviewScalar.description: One scalar in a settings table.

KiCadProjectDiffValueType.description: The encoding of one property value, after KiCad's PROJECT_DIFF.

KiCadProjectDiffScalar.description: A property value: a text, a number or a flag.
